title: VerifiQuant: Governance-by-Execution for Financial LLM Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.26649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models embedded in financial workflows fail most dangerously by emitting confident, well-formatted but wrong numbers with no signal distinguishing them from correct ones. We argue that the central deployment problem is governability: a system must determine when a question supports a numeric answer and when it should instead clarify, intercept, or refuse. We present VerifiQuant, a governance-by-execution framework that packages financial logic into inference contracts and evaluates each query through an executable diagnostic funnel before deterministic computation. This separation makes computation, clarification, and refusal structured and auditable while keeping financial arithmetic outside the language model. translated_title: VerifiQuant：面向金融大语言模型工作流的“执行即治理”框架
translated_abstract: 嵌入金融工作流的大语言模型最危险的失效方式，是输出自信、格式规范但错误的数字，且没有任何信号能将其与正确结果区分开。我们认为，核心的部署问题在于可治理性：系统必须能够判断一个问题何时支持给出数值答案，何时应当转而进行澄清、拦截或拒绝。我们提出VerifiQuant，一个“执行即治理”框架，它将金融逻辑封装为推理契约，并在确定性计算之前通过可执行的诊断漏斗对每个查询进行评估。这种分离使计算、澄清和拒绝变得结构化且可审计，同时将金融算术运算保留在语言模型之外。在声明的契约库范围内，与匹配的检索-执行基线相比，其主要收益并非在有明确答案的问题上获得更高的准确率，而是当输入不足以支持数值答案时表现出更安全的行为。
tldr: VerifiQuant提出“执行即治理”框架，通过将金融逻辑封装为推理契约并用可执行诊断漏斗在计算前评估每个查询，使金融大模型能够结构化、可审计地区分计算、澄清与拒绝，从而在输入不支撑数值答案时实现更安全的行为。
en_tdlr: VerifiQuant is a governance-by-execution framework that packages financial logic into inference contracts and evaluates each query through an executable diagnostic funnel before deterministic computation, enabling structured, auditable computation, clarification, and refusal — with the key benefit being safer behavior when an input does not justify a numeric answer, rather than higher accuracy on well-posed questions.
